registered_predictions_quoted_before_the.a: The planner emits at least one prohibition-shaped success criterion. Observable in plan.success_criteria. Refuted if no criterion quotes a forbidden token list. If (a) is refuted, B17 stays OPEN and the finding is about the planner, not the check.
registered_predictions_quoted_before_the.b: Coverage classifies that criterion as prohibition — not presence, not form. A classifier that reaches the right shape while extracting the wrong tokens is not a pass, so the extracted tokens are quoted as well as the criterion.

cap_arithmetic_stated_before_the_first_c.arithmetic: One unit requested. The fit rule starts a unit only when the sweep's remaining budget is at least the per-unit cap: remaining 0.25 >= per-unit 0.25, so exactly one unit can start, and after it the remaining budget cannot cover a second. Total bound is therefore exactly $0.25 and the request is arithmetically satisfiable — unlike ARCH-20260922-021's exhibit, where --max-spend 0.50 with --repeat 2 needed $1.00 of a $0.50 sweep and exactly one unit could ever start with nothing saying so.
